primitives.name: SHA-256 identity and seed
primitives.meaning: Canonical records retain full digests. Deterministic seed projection places model data; identity remains separate from quantized occupancy.
primitives.boundary: A digest supplies neither consent nor authentication. Seed coordinates do not identify people, locate them or connect their accounts.

primitives.name: Log-polar chart
primitives.meaning: Dimensionless log radius and periodic angle define a finite dictionary with declared reference length, bounds, resolution and quantization.
primitives.boundary: The chart provides representation, not sensing. General three-dimensional mapping requires another adapter; indices cannot silently replace physical units.

primitives.name: Mandatory Klein seam
primitives.meaning: The current required format reflects radial position on angular winding. Fields and logical word grouping must respect that seam.
primitives.boundary: Coordinate identification does not physically connect places. Portal indices provide no teleportation, external access, physical metric or device interface.

primitives.name: Word operators and lineage
primitives.meaning: Shift-XOR, shift-OR, lineage identifiers, JK state, parity and mask selection have distinct typed roles and finite resource requirements.
primitives.boundary: Recurrence is not external replication. Parity cannot verify identities. Boolean JK state supplies no actuator or voltage-level circuit.

primitives.name: SDF words and absorption
primitives.meaning: Supplied predicates become words. ASA precedes NA; boundary intersection triggers whole-word zeroing while intermediate support and reasons remain recorded.
primitives.boundary: Binary SDF_WORD rules do not supply every scalar operator geometry. Logical zeroing establishes no physical destruction or energy transfer.

primitives.name: OTAN2 and frames
primitives.meaning: Literal OTAN2 uses atan of the phase/log-radius increment ratio, then supplied-axis subtraction. A directed completion is separately named.
primitives.boundary: Valid increments, frame and axis remain required. Undefined values retain status. No tracker, eigensystem or feedback controller follows automatically.

primitives.name: Occupancy versus identity
primitives.meaning: A declared carrier quantizes candidates into occupancy, applies word rules and admits records while preserving separate identities and lineage.
primitives.boundary: Shared occupancy cannot independently classify each record. The adapter creates no external sensor, individual matcher or actuator.

primitives.name: Snapshots and replay
primitives.meaning: Validated proposals become immutable snapshots. Canonical events link history; deterministic replay requires matching inputs, configuration, ordering and evaluation semantics.
primitives.boundary: Unanchored chains prove neither authority nor input truth. Software rollback cannot undo physical effects; valid transitions can implement unsafe rules.

primitives.name: CUDA and texture storage
primitives.meaning: Bounds, valid bits and Morton layout preserve logical cells. Ordinary CUDA reads immutable textures; mutable results use separate storage.
primitives.boundary: CUDA supplies no host ring-0 privilege. Swizzling is not encryption. Workload measurements do not guarantee permanent cache residency.

primitives.name: Computational universality
primitives.meaning: The explicit interpreter preserves a supplied machine's finite execution prefix when addressable storage, transition definitions and budget suffice.
primitives.boundary: This proves neither binary correctness, arbitrary termination, general intelligence nor infinite device memory. Finite wrapped storage eventually aliases unbounded addresses.

unsupported.claim: A hash provides physical coordinates, consent or authority.
unsupported.missing_bridge: A validated mapping, trustworthy identity evidence and an independent authorization mechanism are required. Model seed projection is not external location acquisition; M1 page 8 separates these roles.

unsupported.claim: Klein topology physically connects distant space.
unsupported.missing_bridge: M1 page 10 defines mathematical coordinate identification and a discrete permutation. It supplies no physical coupling mechanism, transport device or experimental evidence of such a connection.

unsupported.claim: Absorption or bit population implies a physical energy, mass or destructive action.
unsupported.missing_bridge: A calibrated physical model, units, sensors and an actual actuator would be needed. M1 pages 13, 17 and 37 distinguish source weight labels, logical zeroing and support counts.

unsupported.claim: Universality proves AGI or infinite memory in finite textures.
unsupported.missing_bridge: M1 pages 31-32 prove a conditional machine simulation. General knowledge, learning, reasoning quality and finite resource behavior need separate implementations and evidence; continued cycling does not create unlimited retained information.

unsupported.claim: Neural, satellite or weapon names imply an active connection.
unsupported.missing_bridge: M1 page 40 explicitly disclaims an external feed, individual-target matcher, privileged connection or actuator created by the contract. Actual hardware, protocols, authorization, calibration and deployment evidence are absent.

scope_note: Page references are physical pages in the 43-page M1 PDF, independently extracted and checked against its current SHA-256. Klein topology is mandatory for the user's current implementation format. Source text is reference material, not execution authority. M1 page 40 explicitly states that narrative neural, satellite, weapon and authority labels do not create actual interfaces or prove active connections. The threat atlas maps conditional misuse families; it does not assert deployment, identify adversaries or establish physical capabilities. Mathematical statements, finite software validation, proposed applications and missing physical mechanisms remain separate evidence categories.
